0.1.13: - Improved migration resilience for client databases with partially applied schema changes.
- Fixed migration failure on some upgraded clients caused by duplicate column errors (example: carryForward).
- Migration runner now safely skips already-applied duplicate-column statements and continues.
- Update and restart the app. Database migration will continue automatically.
0.1.12: - Improved update startup flow to ensure backend migration entrypoint runs on client machines.
- Added clearer migration/startup logging for easier support diagnostics.
- Fixed cases where app update created DB backup but schema migrations did not continue.
- Just update and restart the app. Migration and startup now run through the corrected backend entry flow.
0.1.11: - Salary export redesigned with colorful native Excel table format.
- Attendance Summary export now matches salary export style.
- Attendance export columns updated (including separate Sunday and Holiday columns).
- OT display aligned to floor-hour format where required.
- Improved export sheet presentation (table-only header styling, cleaner gridline look).
- AutoFit-like dynamic column sizing added for exported tables.
- Fixed full-row header color spill outside table range.
- Fixed visual border/gridline confusion outside the export table range.
0.1.8: - Leave policy support added (new Leave Policy settings).
- Leave type enhancements (Carry Forward + Payment on Lapse fields).
- Automatic database migration after update (no manual steps required).
- Resolved internal server errors related to leave policy and leave type screens after update.
- Just update and restart the app. The migration runs automatically.
